neet_che_u03_t09_1.working: In SF6, S forms 6 sigma bonds and has no lone pairs, so the steric number is 6. This gives sp3d2 hybridisation and an octahedral shape.

neet_che_u03_t09_2.working: For ClF3: H = 1/2(7 + 3 - 0 + 0) = 5. Five hybrid orbitals means sp3d (3 bond pairs and 2 lone pairs, T-shaped).

neet_che_u03_t09_3.working: The carbons are sp in C2H2 (50% s), sp2 in C2H4 (33.3% s) and sp3 in CH4 (25% s).

neet_che_u03_t09_4.working: PCl5 is sp3d (III). SF6 is sp3d2 (IV). IF7 is sp3d3 (I). [PtCl4]2- is dsp2 (II).

neet_che_u03_t09_5.working: A is true: axial P-Cl bonds are longer and weaker. B is false: hybrid orbitals form only sigma bonds. C is true: [NiCl4]2- is tetrahedral and [Ni(CN)4]2- is square planar. D is false: filled orbitals can also hybridise. E is true: solid PCl5 is [PCl4]+[PCl6]-. So A, C and E are correct.
